rows.note: This is the all-purpose noun for a period of time, including a historical era or a phase in an artist’s career.

example.english: This period was the most confusing time of my life.
example.traditional: 呢段時期係我最迷惘嘅日子。
example.jyutping: ni1 dyun6 si4 kei4 hai6 ngo5 zeoi3 mai4 mong5 ge3 jat6 zi2

rows.note: Use this specifically for a woman’s menstrual period.

example.english: During my period, I usually don't drink cold drinks.
example.traditional: 經期嗰幾日，我通常都唔飲凍嘢。
example.jyutping: ging1 kei4 go2 gei2 jat6 ngo5 tung1 soeng4 dou1 m4 jam2 dung3 je5

rows.note: Use this for the full-stop punctuation mark at the end of a sentence or in an abbreviation.

example.english: This English sentence needs a period at the end.
example.traditional: 呢句英文最後要加句號。
example.jyutping: ni1 geoi3 jing1 man4 zeoi3 hau6 jiu3 gaa1 geoi3 hou6

rows.note: Use this for one numbered division of a school day or a sports game, such as 第二節.

example.english: The next period is physical education, so remember to bring your trainers.
example.traditional: 下一節係體育堂，記得帶波鞋。
example.jyutping: haa6 jat1 zit3 hai6 tai2 juk6 tong4 gei3 dak1 daai3 bo1 haai4
